description: Validation vectors observed from the 2.1.0 Zod schemas. Each case has input (the value after JSON parsing) and, when the raw JSON text matters or the value holds a lone surrogate, input_text. When input_text is present it is the authoritative input. output is JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parsed)) for valid cases; output_text replaces it when the output holds a lone surrogate. issues lists every Zod issue in order with path, code, message, then the remaining Zod fields in key order. rules names semantic rules a case triggers or satisfies (build-history/v2.1.1/appendix/semantic-rules.md).

R1.message: A missing input timestamp needs a reason

R2.message: An available input timestamp cannot also be marked missing

R3.message: An input timestamp needs its documented basis

R4.message: A missing input UTC offset needs a reason

R5.message: An available input UTC offset cannot also be marked missing

R6.message: An input UTC offset needs its documented meaning

R7.message: UTC offset meaning requires UTC offset text

R8.message: A source timezone and its documented meaning must be provided together

R9.message: A provider reporting period needs an ID, date, or start instant

R10.message: Provider reporting period end cannot precede its start

R11.message: A provider UTC offset needs its documented meaning

R12.message: An available provider UTC offset cannot also be marked missing

R13.message: Provide the input value or one missing reason

R14.message: Provide the input unit or one missing reason

R19.message: A reconstructed timestamp needs its base and method, and other timestamps cannot claim them

R20.message: Sleep session end cannot precede its start

R21.message: Workout session end cannot precede its start

R22.message: A score needs duration_s, reps, or weight_kg

R23.message: A provider summary needs an instant or a provider reporting period

R24.message: A provider score needs an instant or a provider reporting period

R26.message: An analysis without causes must mark the error unexplained

R27.message: A planned session needs a date or start instant

R28.message: previous_revision must be null for revision 1 or the prior revision number

R30.message: extension key must be a namespaced extension id

R31.message: extensions cannot contain more than 32 keys

R38.message: A package cannot contain the same current record twice

R39.message: A package cannot contain the same record revision twice

R40.message: A retained revision needs its current record

R41.message: A revision must keep its record type

R42.message: A deletion record needs its retained current record

R43.message: A record can have only one current deletion record

R44.message: A complete package needs every revision through current_revision

R45.message: Record revision numbers must be complete and consecutive

R46.message: The current record must equal its current retained revision

R47.message: A deleted current record needs its deletion record

R48.message: A current deletion record requires is_deleted

R49.message: A deletion record must name the current retained revision

R50.message: A provider import key needs its current record

R51.message: One provider import key cannot identify two records

R52.message: Series file end cannot precede its start

R53.message: Every sample must match the series source and quantity

R54.message: Every current sample must fall inside the series time bounds

R55.message: A package cannot reference the same measurement-series file twice

R56.message: An erased record cannot remain in current package records
